_fragments.faq: See the [FAQ](/faq/) for more program details.
_fragments.deposit: Price shown is the program fee. A separate {{ p.volunteerDeposit }} Volunteer Deposit is added at registration.
_fragments.reqClub: **Club Registration** fee pays for your local coaching, training facilities, equipment, and club operations.
_fragments.reqMembership: **Freestyle BC / Canada Membership** fee is mandatory for every single participant. It provides vital insurance coverage.
_fragments.reqSocks: Trampoline socks available for purchase at Airhouse.
_fragments.reqWaiver: Airhouse waiver to be signed before participation.
_fragments.reqWinterProgram: No drop-ins. No refunds. Athletes must be in the winter program.
_fragments.reqTimberTour: **Timber Tour** competitors will require a [Freestyle BC](https://www.freestylebc.ski/) provincial membership. Upgrades can be made during the season.
_fragments.reqIfsa: **IFSA** competitors will require an [IFSA](https://ifsafreeride.org/) membership plus the regional [Western Canada Freeride](https://www.westerncanadafreeride.ca/) membership.
_fragments.paymentPlan: Payment plan available: email the registrar at [](email:info) to set up. 50% paid at time of registration, 50% paid by e-transfer before the program starts.
